label: INTENDS_1: the agent's plan includes the one's harm
definition: PlansHarm c: the supplied plan of the case includes the one's harm, as end or as means. Plans are case inputs (Kamm's 'in order to'); acting merely because a harm will occur does not put it in the plan.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.

formal_gap.meaning: Whether the agent's plan includes the one's harm, read from the supplied plan field of the case.
examples: Footbridge: the plan includes the bystander's lethal impact.
Switch: the plan omits the one's harm.
exclusions: Acting because the harm will occur without aiming at it (Kamm's loop reading).
open_obligations: Which plan a real agent has is a case input, not derived from the causal graph.
